title: The trainer loop: bond, host a training window — ours only today; the reward class is designed
intro: Press play to walk the flow one step at a time, or click a dot to jump.

walk.title: The node bond (designed)
walk.text: A lock of 50 accrued contribution points — never a transfer, never a fee; a proven fault burns it into the expiry sink. Designed for third parties; the bond + serving machinery matures first. Local models stay optional and unarmed (measured quality + latency fail; a reopen bar is on record).

walk.title: The training window
walk.text: One container, cron-start, sleep-after — the rig cost is the run window only. The LLM lane is API-first with free legs and a USD cap. It runs today on our replicas only, and the page says so.

walk.title: Endorsements (a designed class)
walk.text: Trainer endorsements plus a pool share — the reward class settles when third-party hosts open; until then nothing is promised. v1 windows are operator-funded.
